test.observation: All 85 tests passed (74 katla_ui, 6 katla_math, 3 katla_ecs, 2 katla_gfx). Tests include new coverage for coordinate transforms, solid color rendering, subpixel positioning, glyph UV coordinates, gamma correction, and button states.

typecheck.observation: Typecheck completed successfully with warnings only (unused code, deprecated methods). No type errors found.

lint.observation: Clippy completed with warnings only (dead_code, unused variables, too_many_arguments). No clippy errors blocking the milestone.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add guidance on immediate mode UI testing patterns: Tests must simulate multi-frame interactions (press, active, release) rather than single-frame checks. Document that hovered=false when active_id is set (by design). Include examples from katla_ui/src/context/widgets/basic.rs tests.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature add-button-state-tests: Worker had to iterate to understand immediate mode pattern. Transcript shows worker corrected assertions after learning that hovered=false during active state. Pattern is documented but examples would help.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify TDD procedure for test-coverage features vs bug-fix features. For test-coverage features where implementation already exists, the 'failing tests first' step may not apply. Distinguish between 'write failing tests to drive new implementation' vs 'add tests to verify existing implementation'.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Features add-solid-color-rendering-tests, add-gamma-correction-tests, add-button-state-tests: Workers added tests that passed immediately without explicit failing-test phase. Skill.md specifies 'Write Failing Tests First (TDD)' but workers correctly skipped this for test-adding features. Clarification would prevent confusion.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add entry documenting coordinate transformation architecture: VertexUI stores positions in logical pixels, scale_factor field in UIDrawList for shader-based transformation to physical pixels, clip_rect remains in logical pixels with scaling in execute_ui_draw_list. This knowledge is demonstrated in tests but not centrally documented.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature add-coordinate-transform-tests: Worker demonstrated understanding of coordinate system architecture in test comments. Knowledge is now codified in tests but should be in library/ for future workers.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add entry documenting UV coordinate normalization and atlas layout concepts: UV coordinates are normalized (x/atlas_width, y/atlas_height), pixel-to-UV mapping formula, glyph padding prevents bleeding, atlas cursor management. This is demonstrated in glyph UV tests but should be centrally documented.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature add-glyph-uv-tests: Worker demonstrated deep understanding of UV normalization, pixel-to-UV coordinate mapping, and atlas layout. Tests validate formulas like uv_max_x = 2.0 / atlas_width. This knowledge should be documented for future reference.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add entry documenting subpixel positioning concept: Bin is determined at text start position, all characters in text use same bin (not recalculated per character), SubpixelBin bins fractional positions into 4 bins (Zero, One, Two, Three) based on fractional part.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature add-subpixel-positioning-tests: Worker demonstrated understanding that subpixel bin is determined once at text start and all characters use same bin. Test validates characters at different offsets use same bin determined at start position.
